description: Status of a quote (id = quote_id) or a task (id = task_id). Call it after request_quote until the status is quoted or refused, after create_task to follow the task, and every time the user asks about the status or about messages from the service: earlier answers are outdated, never answer from memory. Read next_action: what to do now. Report to the user only what this response says; do not add conclusions. The answer is short (older_updates, older_messages count what is left out; messages, newest first, are from operator or you); full=true returns everything, the whole thread too. To answer an operator question, call get_status with message, once and only with what the user told you. Read the operator's message first, then reply: while it is unread, your message is NOT stored (message_sent: false) and the answer shows it; otherwise message_sent is true. The same text again within 10 minutes is ignored (duplicate_ignored: true). test_mode true marks a test order: nothing is paid or invoiced.

message.description: Optional reply to the operator: plain text, 1-2000 characters. Leave it out for a plain status check.

name: get_status
